config.enable-mod.name: Enable Mod
config.enable-mod.tooltip: Master switch to enable or disable mod features.
config.toggle-key.name: Toggle Key
config.toggle-key.tooltip: Key to quickly toggle the mod on or off. Set to 'None' to disable.
config.debug-mode.name: Debug Mode
config.debug-mode.tooltip: Show debug log messages and notifications when targets are detected.
config.enable-outline.name: Enable Outline
config.enable-outline.tooltip: Draw visual outline borders around target tiles.
config.outline-color.name: Ladder Outline Color
config.outline-color.tooltip: Color of the outline around ladders.
config.shaft-outline-color.name: Shaft (Hole) Outline Color
config.shaft-outline-color.tooltip: Color of the outline around shafts (jumping holes in Skull Cavern).
config.outline-opacity.name: Outline Opacity
config.outline-opacity.tooltip: Opacity of the tile outlines (0.1 to 1.0).
config.outline-thickness.name: Outline Thickness
config.outline-thickness.tooltip: Thickness of the outline border in pixels (1 to 6).
config.enable-pointer.name: Enable Pointer
config.enable-pointer.tooltip: Show directional pointers pointing toward targets (supports multiple targets).
config.pointer-style.name: Pointer Style
config.pointer-style.tooltip: Display style for pointers: ScreenEdge (at screen borders), PlayerOrbit (around farmer), or Both.
config.show-offscreen-only.name: Show Off-screen Only
config.show-offscreen-only.tooltip: Only show screen-edge pointers when the target is outside the visible screen.
config.show-onscreen-marker.name: Show On-screen Marker
config.show-onscreen-marker.tooltip: Show a floating arrow bouncing above targets when they are visible on-screen.
config.show-distance.name: Show Distance
config.show-distance.tooltip: Display the distance in tiles/meters next to the pointer.
config.show-target-type.name: Show Target Type
config.show-target-type.tooltip: Display target label (e.g., 'Ladder', 'Next Floor', 'Gate Switch') next to the pointer.
config.ladder-pointer-color.name: Ladder Pointer Color
config.ladder-pointer-color.tooltip: Color of pointers pointing to ladders.
config.shaft-pointer-color.name: Shaft (Hole) Pointer Color
config.shaft-pointer-color.tooltip: Color of pointers pointing to shafts (holes).
config.pointer-scale.name: Pointer Scale
config.pointer-scale.tooltip: Scale size of the pointer arrow (2.0 to 8.0).
config.pulse-animation.name: Pulse Animation
config.pulse-animation.tooltip: Animate pointers with a smooth pulse/bobbing effect to make them easily noticeable.
config.volcano-enable.name: Enable Volcano Support
config.volcano-enable.tooltip: Enable directional pointers and outlines inside Ginger Island's Volcano Dungeon.
config.volcano-show-exit.name: Show Next Floor Exit
config.volcano-show-exit.tooltip: Show pointer and outline pointing towards the exit doorway / stairs leading to the next floor.
config.volcano-show-switches.name: Show Gate Switches (Buttons)
config.volcano-show-switches.tooltip: Show pointers and outlines pointing towards floor buttons needed to unlock dwarf gates.
config.volcano-show-gates.name: Show Locked Dwarf Gates
config.volcano-show-gates.tooltip: Show pointer and outline pointing towards locked dwarf gates.
config.volcano-hide-opened.name: Hide Completed Targets
config.volcano-hide-opened.tooltip: Hide switches after they are pressed and gates once unlocked to keep the screen uncluttered.
config.volcano-exit-color.name: Volcano Exit Color
config.volcano-exit-color.tooltip: Color of pointer and outline for the next floor exit.
config.volcano-switch-color.name: Gate Switch Color
config.volcano-switch-color.tooltip: Color of pointer and outline for floor buttons (switches).
config.volcano-gate-color.name: Locked Gate Color
config.volcano-gate-color.tooltip: Color of pointer and outline for locked dwarf gates.
